_meta.description: One member of a rating battery as a crosstab cell: AGG_VEC_MEAN over the survey's six ratings (survey.pulse, a named vector with display labels) with params.element "value_fair" reads that member alone, so each (panel, q3 band of width 2) cell is the mean q4 rating, a scalar like AGG_AVERAGE's on the same column; it rises from about 3.0 in the lowest q3 band to about 5.2 in the highest, the correlation between the survey's two factors. Without element an array-valued aggregator is refused as a cell (PROCESSING_CONFIG reason array_valued). The cell floor counts the rows where that member answered; margins are recomputed from those rows, and a margin_aggregations entry may name its own element: here the margins also carry the SD of the same member (AGG_VEC_SD, element "value_fair"), under Components.crosstab row_margin_aggregations / column_margin_aggregations / grand_total_aggregations. A record reaches an auxiliary margin only if it reached a CELL. element is a member's display label (the vector's labels, else the member name), is refused outside a crosstab and beside expand, and fuses like the scalar twin.
_meta.name: crosstab_vector_element_cells
